title: The Gate That Stayed Shut
purpose: Voice recording and content integration catalogue. Conditions are authoring notes, not executable gameplay rules. Player choices, letters, rewards, and full scene directions remain in the screenplay.

dialogue.speaker: REMEMBERED VOICE
dialogue.text: Alden! There are still people inside!

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Close the gate.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: You’re early.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Then you’ve already learned to listen. Come in.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: A busy head needs something useful to do. Come in.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: People say many things about this yard. You may judge this one for yourself.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: What brought you here?

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: A practical answer. Let’s see that you live long enough to spend it.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Choose the people beside you carefully. Their promises will become your work.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: That answer will cost you more than the first two.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: For today, these are yours. Put the shield on your left. The sword goes in your right.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Your first task is to learn what you can control.

dialogue.speaker: HERALD
dialogue.text: By command of King Orren: the Crown Tournament shall name the protector of his heir. Candidates must bear the seals of the Five Masters. The lists are open to orders and independent champions.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: There is no order left to send me. And the Crown struck my name from the lists.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: A banner is easy to make. We’ll begin with the person beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: The king is dying, Alden. His messengers are already on the road. If your student intends to earn five seals, you should let them leave this yard eventually.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: After they can keep a shield up.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: Then I’ll be in the lists. Bring them before sunset.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: We have time for a first lesson.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: A shield can stop a blade. Your feet must still carry you out of its way.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Show me one slow movement first. We’ll use a range you can repeat comfortably.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Ready. Lower, then return to your starting position.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Good. Remember that control when someone asks you to hurry.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Your sword will feel heavier near the end of a duel. We’ll prepare for that now.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Choose the variation you can manage today.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: One slow repetition for the view. Then we’ll begin your set.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Lower, return, and let me see you reset.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Enough for this lesson. You have a steadier foundation to work from.

dialogue.context: Block C — Breath: marching or jogging in place
dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: A duel lasts longer than its first exchange.

dialogue.context: Block C — Breath: marching or jogging in place
dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Stay in your space. Find a pace you can maintain.

dialogue.context: Block C — Breath: marching or jogging in place
dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Keep your pace.

dialogue.context: Block C — Breath: marching or jogging in place
dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Five seconds remain.

dialogue.context: Block C — Breath: marching or jogging in place
dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Now you know the pace you can return to.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Those three lessons will stay with you: a measured strike, a sure recovery, and enough breath for another exchange.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Keep what you’ve learned today. There’s time for the rest.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: We can return to that lesson. Let’s work with what you have today.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Raise your shield. Your left hand places it. Hold your guard.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: There. Keep the opening above the shield in mind.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Your blade follows your wrist and forearm. Make one measured cut, then recover.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: A clear movement. Let the blade recover before the next.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Finally, shift into the space beside you.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: A small opening is often enough.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Guard spends stamina. Striking spends stamina. Lower your guard between exchanges and give yourself time to recover.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: Will you explain every duel before allowing one?

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Only their first.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: Then bring your squire.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: We fight until one of us yields. The blades are blunted for the lists. Read my guard, protect your line, and watch your stamina.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: Then you’ll remember this one.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: We’ll find out.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: You learn where your guard failed. Then you choose whether to try again.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Watch her shoulders. She’ll show you where the next strike begins.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Cover the high line.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Her blade comes from the left.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.condition: if the player repeatedly attacks the guard
dialogue.text: Cover the right, or move aside.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.condition: if the player waits and counters
dialogue.text: Better. You made me commit.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.condition: low stamina, once per low-stamina episode
dialogue.text: Make room. Let your stamina return.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Hold. We’ll continue when I can see you.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: Enough. I yield. Your trial.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: That was your first trial. Remember what worked.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: You may enjoy that compliment. He rarely gives them.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: Ilyra Dane keeps the first master’s seal at Ironbridge. Tell her I sent you. She’ll still make you earn it.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: Enough. You yield. My trial.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Take a moment. Then we’ll look at the exchange that cost you.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: You can try me again before we leave.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: At Ironbridge, ask for Ilyra Dane. Tell her you still have work to do. She’ll appreciate an honest introduction.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: The road has purses larger than this one. Keep enough coin to reach them.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: You kept coming back into the exchange. An order can use someone who does that.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: You ask direct questions. Keep that habit when you reach the masters.

dialogue.speaker: TOMAS
dialogue.text: Alden’s new squire. I wondered who’d be leaving my door with that shield.

dialogue.speaker: TOMAS
dialogue.text: I’ve repaired it often enough to claim some credit.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Twenty coins for the road.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: An investment. Spend it with thought.

dialogue.speaker: TOMAS
dialogue.text: Your kit will get you to Ironbridge. If you want an upgrade, choose what you expect to need.

dialogue.speaker: TOMAS
dialogue.text: A good edge. Remember what it asks of your arm.

dialogue.speaker: TOMAS
dialogue.text: More cover. Remember what it weighs.

dialogue.speaker: TOMAS
dialogue.text: A sensible traveller knows what they can afford.

dialogue.speaker: TOMAS
dialogue.text: Keep your purse. Your present kit still has work in it.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: The Crown Tournament takes individual champions. The road belongs to orders.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: You may. You’ll still need the five seals.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: When you have companions, put a name to your order. Challenge another. Three fighters from each side; each has a duel. Your victories belong to the people beside you as well.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: An order begins when someone else can depend on you.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: I’ll remember your banner when it reaches the lists.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: Then I’ll remember your name.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: This came with the proclamation. It was addressed to the next person he trained.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: My first squire.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: I gave an order.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: I’ll try to deserve that.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: You will hear it. Some of it must come from people who were there.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: You should. Ask the masters as well.

dialogue.speaker: MARA
dialogue.text: Ironbridge is two days east.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: Ilyra saw the gate before it burned. Begin with her.

dialogue.speaker: ALDEN
dialogue.text: At dawn, you leave.
